comment: Oh Captain, My Captain's thaumaturge (quest battle 39, drop-in layer QB_SubWil088_001). From Bob's Chronofoil capture of 2026-10-18 (three runs): level 15, 382 HP; no auto-attack, a spell every 6-8 s on the player from where he stands (14 yalms away and more): Fire and Blizzard, Blizzard II (around him) when the player was close, Fire II now and then. Hitbox not recorded.
